title: Bashal'Aran
wikitext:
[[image:Bashal'Aran.jpg|thumb|The ruins of Bashal'Aran]]

To the northeast of [[Auberdine]] in [[Darkshore]] you will find the ruins of '''Bashal'Aran''' {{Coords|45|36|Darkshore}}.
The ruins are overrun with [[demon]]ic minions - [[sprite]]s and [[satyr]]s which have taken up residence in the area. These evil creatures feed upon the magical energies left among the ruins, their powers growing from the continued exposure.
